coming of age = the time when a young person is legally or socially recognised as an adult
condolences = formal expressions of sympathy after someone has died
housewarming = a party to celebrate moving into a new home
stag do = a party for a man before he gets married, usually with male friends
hen do = a party for a woman before she gets married, usually with female friends
wedding reception = the meal and party after a marriage ceremony
propose a toast = to invite guests to raise their glasses and wish someone well
bereavement = the state of having lost a close person through death
mourning = the period and customs of showing sadness after a death
milestone = an important event that marks progress in a life
rite of passage = a ceremony or experience that marks a new stage of life
christening = a Christian ceremony in which a baby is named and welcomed
mark an anniversary = to celebrate or remember a date each year
wedding vows = the promises a couple make to each other during the ceremony
registry office = a government office where civil marriages and births are recorded
civil ceremony = a legal wedding without a religious service
anniversary = a date you remember each year because something important happened then
family gathering = an occasion when relatives meet together
circle of friends = the group of people you spend time with socially
me time = time spent doing something for your own rest or hobby
